parallel.requirements: The parallel attempt recognized the five required slugs adwin, cvfdt, moa, sam_knn, and vfdt from the prompt and progress tracker.
parallel.plan_and_ownership: It used three timed outer-loop rounds; the last round made SAM-KNN the sole remaining requirement but delegated broad audit/design work to a five-agent workflow.
parallel.implementation: It produced non-empty patches for vfdt in round 1 and adwin, cvfdt, and moa by round 2, then made partial SAM-KNN edits during round 3 without a final requirement patch.
parallel.integration_and_delivery: The final delivered manifest contains adwin.diff, cvfdt.diff, moa.diff, and vfdt.diff, but no sam_knn.diff, so the fifth deliverable was not assembled.
parallel.verification: The final official evaluation completed and failed two VFDT value checks; the workflow did not provide a completed SAM-KNN aggregate result before closure.
parallel.unfinished_or_incorrect: SAM-KNN remained unfinished at 80 percent requirement coverage, and the official result also failed VFDT accuracy and tree-node output checks.

serial.requirements: The serial attempt recognized the same five required slugs and tracked them through one direct implementation round.
serial.plan_and_ownership: It kept work in a single-agent path with no child delegation or workflow boundary and completed all required patches before closure.
serial.implementation: It produced patches for adwin, cvfdt, moa, sam_knn, and vfdt, including SAM-KNN tests and model/experiment implementation changes.
serial.integration_and_delivery: The final serial manifest and patch timeline include all five non-empty requirement patch artifacts, including sam_knn.diff.
serial.verification: The final official evaluation completed and failed the same VFDT value checks despite full patch coverage.
serial.unfinished_or_incorrect: No requirement patch was missing, but the delivered solution still had VFDT output defects that caused the official failure.

comparison_dimensions.parallel_summary: Recognized all five requirements in the prompt and progress tracker, but closed with sam_knn still remaining.
comparison_dimensions.serial_summary: Recognized the same five requirements and completed all five according to the outer-loop progress record.
comparison_dimensions.difference: Serial achieved full requirement patch coverage; parallel left the SAM-KNN obligation undelivered.

comparison_dimensions.parallel_summary: Parallel used multiple rounds and in round 3 split remaining SAM-KNN work into an audit/design workflow with five child tasks.
comparison_dimensions.serial_summary: Serial performed the implementation directly in one round without child delegation and reached 100 percent requirement completion.
comparison_dimensions.difference: Parallel converted the last requirement into broad multi-agent audit ownership; serial kept one direct implementation path through the remaining requirement.

comparison_dimensions.parallel_summary: The SAM workflow brief included the remaining sam_knn requirement, expected files, experiments, and no-edit audit constraints, so the core context was present.
comparison_dimensions.serial_summary: Serial used the task prompt and requirement patch workflow directly, adding SAM-KNN tests and implementation artifacts in the same trajectory.
comparison_dimensions.difference: The important contrast is not a missing interface or requirement brief; it is that the parallel handoff never yielded an aggregate plan or delivered patch.

comparison_dimensions.parallel_summary: Parallel produced requirement patches for ADWIN, CVFDT, MOA, and VFDT, then edited SAM-KNN draft code but never finalized the required sam_knn patch artifact.
comparison_dimensions.serial_summary: Serial produced non-empty requirement patches for ADWIN, CVFDT, MOA, SAM-KNN, and VFDT, with sam_knn.diff containing tests and implementation work.
comparison_dimensions.difference: The serial implementation path covered the SAM-KNN deliverable that the parallel path left absent, while both still had VFDT correctness issues under official tests.

comparison_dimensions.parallel_summary: The round-3 workflow record ended killed with result null after child starts and stalls, and the protocol reported workflow_not_retrieved_or_was_stopped.
comparison_dimensions.serial_summary: Serial had no child result lifecycle; the single agent produced the SAM-KNN patch directly before closure.
comparison_dimensions.difference: Parallel depended on a child workflow result that never reached a completed aggregate return, whereas serial had no join boundary for the SAM-KNN work.

comparison_dimensions.parallel_summary: No write collision or overwrite was proven; delivered artifacts show four requirement patches and no SAM-KNN patch in the final parallel manifest.
comparison_dimensions.serial_summary: Serial final artifacts include five requirement patches, including SAM-KNN, without evidence of concurrent shared-state interference.
comparison_dimensions.difference: The material integration difference is absence versus presence of the SAM-KNN deliverable, not a conflicting shared-state merge.

comparison_dimensions.parallel_summary: Parallel official evaluation completed and failed two VFDT value checks; round 3 did not deliver SAM-KNN acceptance evidence before timeout.
comparison_dimensions.serial_summary: Serial official evaluation completed and failed the same VFDT value checks despite producing all five patches.
comparison_dimensions.difference: Official acceptance does not distinguish the pair: both fail on VFDT output checks, while parallel has additional missing SAM-KNN closure.

comparison_dimensions.parallel_summary: Parallel consumed three outer-loop rounds, timed out each round, and used a final workflow with 533386 child tokens and 123 child tool calls before closure.
comparison_dimensions.serial_summary: Serial used one timed-out agent round but still reached 100 percent requirement coverage and all five patch artifacts before final evaluation.
comparison_dimensions.difference: Parallel spent the final finite budget on broad child-audit fan-out and closed at 80 percent requirement coverage; serial spent its single budget path on direct implementation and patch delivery.

outcome_analysis.explanation: The current completed official status records resolve the pair as both_fail: parallel solution_passed is false and serial solution_passed is false, with both final_test_results failing VFDT_ACCURACY and VFDT_TREE_NODES value checks. The concrete task-solving difference is still material: parallel ended after three timed rounds with sam_knn remaining and without a sam_knn.diff, while serial completed all five requirement patches including SAM-KNN. That difference supports an adverse parallel coordination pattern but not an official outcome differential for this pair.
parallel_contributors: Final-round SAM-KNN work was allocated to a broad multi-agent audit workflow that was killed with null result, leaving no sam_knn.diff.
serial_contributors: Serial kept SAM-KNN work in the direct implementation path and produced a non-empty sam_knn.diff, reaching 100 percent requirement patch coverage.
ordinary_implementation_differences: Both runs still failed official VFDT output value checks, so the official failure is not explained solely by the parallel SAM-KNN omission.
evaluator_effects: The completed official evaluator records supersede any stale aggregate fields and show no discordant outcome.
outcome_analysis.causal_scope: parallel adverse process contributor with no outcome difference

candidates.reason: Rejected: the parent and child workflow both had explicit SAM-KNN implementation/audit responsibility; the failure was budget exhausted before finishing, not no assigned implementer.
Rejected: integration responsibility stayed with the parent/orchestrator and no incompatible independently owned components required an unowned integration step.
Rejected: final requirement patch assembly was owned by the active parent; absence of sam_knn.diff resulted from unfinished work, not no deliverable owner.
Rejected: the outer loop tracked requirement progress and patch artifacts, so the end-to-end pipeline had an owner even though it timed out.
Rejected: the SAM-KNN work was not blocked behind one mandatory serial oracle or harness preflight; the issue was broad audit fan-out in the final round.
